application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description:
Internal and External alterations to the building located within Conservation area.
The proposed works seek to improve the internal layout of the dwelling to better accommodate the needs of a young family. The reconfigured layout includes the introduction of a protected stairway, ensuring that the property complies with current fire safety requirements as set out in Approved Document Part B of the Building Regulations.
The proposals include the installation of large patio doors to the rear elevation, providing improved connectivity between the internal living spaces and the external garden area. Replacement windows, a new front door, and a garage door are also proposed, which will enhance the consistency of the front elevation and reinforce the traditional character and appearance of the building.
Roof works are proposed to improve the performance and longevity of the building while maintaining its traditional appearance. The main pitched roof will be re-covered using plain tiles on a like-for-like basis. Existing mono pitched roof of first floor will be replaced with the flat finished with GRP fibreglass, incorporating lead-effect roll detailing. In addition, conservation-style roof windows are proposed to minimise visual impact and preserve the character of the property.
The property is currently in relatively good condition; however, the proposed works will enhance appearance and significantly improve its energy efficiency, safety, and overall compliance with current Building Regulations.
There are no changes proposed to access arrangements, which will remain as existing.

Works:
- Alterations to the internal floor layouts.
- Alterations to window and door fenestration on the front and rear elevations.
- Replacement of the existing mono-pitch roofs over the rear and side single-storey extensions with flat roofs. The proposed flat roofs will be finished in GRP fibreglass, incorporating roll 	detailing to provide a traditional aesthetic.
- Installation of rooflights to the rear and side flat roofs.
- Replacement of the existing roof tiles on the main roof on a like-for-like basis.
- Replacement of the existing roof window with a conservation-style roof window, and installation of a new roof window on the opposite roof pitch.
- Re-covering of the existing porch roof with lead sheets, detailed with rolled joints.
